info.prompt: A dynamic action illustration of HEIST mode climax showing vault theft in progress: a thief's crimson energy tendrils lashing toward the glowing central vault as other players' blocking attempts manifest as jagged amber barriers, the vault itself a pulsating orb of liquid gold suspended in a web of SHA-256 hash strings, background filled with the game's signature bio-architectural elements—neural lattice wiring, crystalline structural supports, and skeletal UI frames etched with FNV-1a derived avatar patterns.
